notes: Identity inspected independently: canonical text begins Gettierized Knobe Effects, James R. Beebe and Joseph Shea (University at Buffalo), Episteme (forthcoming), and contains the primary authors’ experiments, methods, results, conclusion and references over manuscript pages 1–38. Title, authors and journal match the supplied original reference. This is an author manuscript, not the final journal pagination; supplied DOI, year and volume/page details are not printed in the manuscript header and cannot be independently confirmed from this source. No PDF is supplied. Experiment 1 has four distinct fulfill/violate vignette comparisons, all fitting the supplied neutral description: WATER (rise/fall), MOVIES (improve/drop), SALES (increase/decrease), NAZI (fulfill/violate). Printed p. 14 footnote 7 candidates: WATER t(88) = -2.462, p < .05, r = .25; MOVIES t(92) = -1.804, p > .05, r = .18; SALES t(92) = -1.807, p > .05, r = .19; NAZI t(90) = -5.15, p < .0001, r = .48. Footnote 8 also prints the pooled fulfill/violate main effect F(1, 368) = 31.127, p < .001, r = .28. These are candidate evidence only, not assigned values. The supplied p. 9 locator describes WATER measurement and introduces MOVIES but does not identify one critical comparison; no row-specific vignette or test is supplied. Four identical row descriptions do not license allocating these four comparisons by row order. Manuscript p. 11 reports 376 undergraduate participants across the entire between-subjects Experiment 1. It does not explicitly report final mutually exclusive group counts or an analytic N for each pairwise test. No N is derived from degrees of freedom, and 376 is retained only as an experiment-wide participant count candidate, not an assigned analytic N. Exclusions for the candidate pairwise tests are not established. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
